title: Follow up qa-v1-theory-3c0e6ff46a7cf4a536a21159
behavioral_concerns: follow up: ApprovedQAChecks argument validation allows non-flag arguments that contain no shell metachars but are still outside budgets or escape via cleaned relative paths; attacker-controlled changed-path set could influence descriptor args via goPaths concatenation without per-path normalization check for absolute or .. after FromSlash clean.

evidence.summary: validateQACheckDescriptor only checks shell metachars and inside, no budget check for non-flag args; Args built as append("-d",goPaths...)
validateQAPath checks IsAbs and Clean(FromSlash) prefix ../, and inside uses Rel Clean to bound target
QABudgets definition shows ChangedPaths 512 and command/timeout budgets enforced only for Timeout/OutputLimit, not arg count

theories.claim: ApprovedQAChecks descriptor validation allows non-flag arguments that bypass budget containment while attacker-controlled goPaths are concatenated into gofmt argv
theories.basis: ApprovedQAChecks at internal/sprint/qa_prompt.go:59-87 builds goPaths from normalizeQAStrings(changedPaths) after validateQAPath and appends all .go paths to descriptor Args -d without per-path budget check; validateQACheckDescriptor at 89-125 for non-flag args only checks ContainsAny "\x00\r\n|;&><`$()" , -w/--write, and inside(target, Join(target,FromSlash(arg))) + IsAbs, but never checks QABudgets.ChangedPaths/ChangedPathsPerShard/PromptBytes/CommandOutputBytes or arg count/length; exploited changed-path set directly controls number and content of gofmt positional arguments
theories.verification_surface: internal/sprint/qa_prompt.go:59-87 ApprovedQAChecks goPaths concatenation; internal/sprint/qa_prompt.go:89-125 validateQACheckDescriptor non-flag branch; internal/sprint/qa_map.go:287-292 validateQAPath; internal/sprint/qa_types.go:85-112 QABudgets limits; internal/sprint/artifacts.go:77-83 inside
theories.confirmation_condition: statically observable that a .go path passes validateQAPath and ContainsAny check and inside==true yet argument list length or total bytes exceeds MaximumQABudgets or map budgets and would still be accepted by validateQACheckDescriptor and executed as gofmt -d positional arg
theories.refutation_condition: every non-flag arg is also bounded by an explicit check against QABudgets.ChangedPaths/ChangedPathsPerShard and total arg bytes/prompt bytes before descriptor is accepted, or ApprovedQAChecks truncates goPaths to budget before concatenation
theories.inconclusive_condition: static reading shows gap but no runtime RunApprovedQACheck execution observed to prove attacker-supplied path outside budget is actually executed
theories.safe_evidence_strategy: read-only grep and read of qa_prompt.go, qa_map.go, qa_types.go, artifacts.go; compare validateQAPath and inside logic to budget enforcement in ValidateQAMap/BuildQAMap without invoking shell, writing files, or running process

theories.outcome_reason: Code inspection confirms validateQACheckDescriptor has no budget check for non-flag positional args; ApprovedQAChecks concatenates all goPaths (up to budgets.ChangedPaths=512) into Args and fingerprint without length/budget guard, only Timeout/OutputLimit are checked at 101. Static gap is deterministically present.

theories.claim: Attacker-controlled changed-path set can escape target via cleaned relative path through FromSlash clean without per-path absolute/.. check after clean in descriptor args
theories.basis: Concern alleges goPaths concatenation lacks per-path normalization check for absolute or .. after FromSlash clean, allowing ../-prefixed or absolute path that contains no shell metachars to pass descriptor validation via inside() after Join; must verify whether validateQAPath at qa_map.go:288 using Clean(FromSlash(path)) prefix "../" and IsAbs plus validateQACheckDescriptor at qa_prompt.go:114-117 using IsAbs(arg) and !inside(target, Join(target,FromSlash(arg))) together are sufficient
theories.verification_surface: internal/sprint/qa_prompt.go:63-71 validateQAPath loop before goPaths append; internal/sprint/qa_prompt.go:113-118 escape check; internal/sprint/qa_map.go:287-292 validateQAPath implementation; internal/sprint/artifacts.go:77-83 inside with Rel Clean
theories.confirmation_condition: existence of a relative path that passes validateQAPath (prefix ../ false, IsAbs false) yet after Join(target,FromSlash) inside returns true while effective cleaned path references outside target, or an absolute path that bypasses IsAbs due to FromSlash normalization
theories.refutation_condition: every absolute path and any path where Clean(FromSlash) has prefix "../" is rejected before goPaths append, and every descriptor non-flag arg with IsAbs or !inside is rejected, with no bypass via intermediate ".." that normalizes inside target but still escapes
theories.inconclusive_condition: read-only inspection shows both checks use Clean/Rel, but corner cases such as Windows volume, double-slash, or symlink-contained paths require runtime inside() evaluation to confirm no bypass
theories.safe_evidence_strategy: read-only read of validateQAPath, inside, and descriptor loop; manual trace of candidate paths like "a/../../b.go", "../a.go", "/etc/passwd", "a//..//b.go" through Clean->prefix and Join->inside without executing or creating symlinks

Combined checks deterministically reject absolute and escaping cleaned relative paths. Budget gap remains but path-escape via cleaned relative is blocked in current code.
